Detailed Description

This class implements the interface to Honeywell Velocity Radar System (HRVS).
The interface allows to configure, execute the measurement and process the measurement data.

Note
Used terms:
  • Radar System - HRVS SDK API.
  • Radar System Host - A platform the Radar System is running on.
  • HRVS - Honeywell Velocity Radar System.
  • Radar - Instance of radar the HRVS consists from.
  • UART - Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter.
  • GPIO - General Purpose Input Output.

◆ RadarMessageError

enum hrvs_sdk::RadarSystem::RadarMessageError : uint8_t

Enum used to give more info about ReturnCode::ERR_RADAR_MSG error.

Enumerator
NO_MSG_ERR 

No error set.

MSG_TIMEOUT 

Timeout while receiving message via UART from HRVS.

MSG_CORRUPTED 

Received message from HRVS is corrupted (computed and received checksum does not match).

UNEXPECTED_MSG_TYPE 

Received message with unexpected type (expected message type ID and received message type ID does not match).

UNEXPECTED_RADAR 

Received message from unexpected radar (expected radar ID and received message radar ID does not match).

RADAR_ERR 

Radar error identified by special radarId (0xFF) in minrange message.

enum hrvs_sdk::RadarSystem::ReturnCode : uint8_t

All return codes of API non-void methods.

Enumerator
OK 

Method succesfully completed.

System is in state in which method can not be called. Possible transitions can be seen on image included in documentation.

Error caused by user provided UART interface instance (some interface method has thrown false value).

Error arised during radar message reception from HRVS or radar message verification.

Entered index is out of range.

Error caused by SDK implementation (e.g. insufficient buffer lengths).

Error signaled by EAP model (maskIn / maskOut are not zero).

hrvs_sdk::RadarSystem::RadarSystem ( bool  debugModeEnable = false,

Constructor of RadarSystem.

Parameters
[in]debugModeEnableDebug mode enables injection of velocities and ranges to radars (feature available in all SDK libraries). Enables logging all messages transmitted between Radar System Host and HRVS to csv files inside "hrvsSdkLogs_N" folders (feature available only in SDK libraries compiled with C++ standard library). Enables extended TRACE logging of HRVS SDK operations (feature available only in SDK libraries compiled with C++ standard library). Use this option only for testing purposes, as it may slow down the system.
[in]debugFolderPathPath to folder where folder with HRVS SDK logs, folder with name "hrvsSdkLogs_N", is created when debug mode is enabled. Default path "./" is used when debug mode is enabled and this parameter is nullptr.

◆ getRadarSystemState()

void hrvs_sdk::RadarSystem::getRadarSystemState ( unsigned &  systemFrameNumber,
SystemState &  systemState,
unsigned long long &  status,
unsigned &  resetErrorCounter 
) const

Get radar system state.

Parameters
[out]systemFrameNumberReference where is copied current radar system frame number.
[out]systemStateReference where is copied current radar system state.
[out]statusReference where is copied status of lastly perfomed radar system method.

********************************************************************
Status variable description:
Return code of HRVS SDK API methods provide just limited information about arrised error.
More detailed information about arrised error can be extracted from variable with status of
lastly performed HRVS SDK API method (further simply called status variable). Status variable
is accessible by one of output parameters of method: getSystemStatus(). Content of status
variable depends on arrised error type, i.e. depends on return code of HRVS SDK API method:

******************************* VOID *******************************

All void methods, except closeRadarSystem(), fill status variable followingly:

MSB 54b 8b LSB
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|
| UNUSED | METHOD |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|

Items:
METHOD - ID of lastly performed method (see enum Methods)

********************************************************************

Method closeRadarSystem() fills status variable followingly:

MSB 54b 1b 1b 8b LSB
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|–|–|-------------—|
| UNUSED |C1|C0| METHOD |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|–|–|-------------—|

Items:
METHOD - Methods::CLOSE_RADAR_SYSTEM
C0 - EAP UART close status (0 - success / 1 - fail)
C1 - GPIO close status (0 - success / 1 - fail)


************************** ReturnCode::OK **************************

MSB 48b 8b 8b LSB
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|-------------—|
| UNUSED | RETURN CODE | METHOD |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|-------------—|

Items:
METHOD - ID of lastly performed method (see enum Methods)
RETURN CODE - ReturnCode::OK

****************** ReturnCode::METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED ******************

MSB 48b 8b 8b LSB
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|-------------—|
| UNUSED | RETURN CODE | METHOD |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|-------------—|

Items:
METHOD - ID of lastly performed method (see enum Methods)
RETURN CODE - ReturnCode::METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED

****************** ReturnCode::NULLPTR_ASSIGNMENT ******************

MSB 44 bit 1b 1b 1b 1b 8b 8b LSB
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|–|–|–|–|-------------—|-------------—|
| UNUSED |N4|N3|N2|N1| RETURN CODE | METHOD |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|–|–|–|–|-------------—|-------------—|

Items:
METHOD - ID of lastly performed method (see enum Methods)
RETURN CODE - ReturnCode::NULLPTR_ASSIGNMENT
N1 - EAP UART interface assignment (0 - OK / 1 - nullptr)
N2 - GPIO interface assignment (0 - OK / 1 - nullptr)
N3 - thread interface assignment (0 - OK / 1 - nullptr)
N4 - time interface assignment (0 - OK / 1 - nullptr)


*********************** ReturnCode::ERR_UART ***********************

MSB 40b 8b 8b 8b 8b LSB
|-------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|
| UNUSED | UART ERROR | UART INSTANCE | RETURN CODE | METHOD |
|-------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|

Items:
METHOD - ID of lastly performed method (see enum Methods)
RETURN CODE - ReturnCode::ERR_UART
UART INSTANCE - instance of UART interface causing error (see enum UartInstance)
UART ERROR - type of error (see enum UartError)

*********************** ReturnCode::ERR_GPIO ***********************

MSB 40b 8b 8b 8b LSB
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|
| UNUSED | GPIO ERROR | RETURN CODE | METHOD |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|

Items:
METHOD - ID of lastly performed method (see enum Methods)
RETURN CODE - ReturnCode::ERR_GPIO
GPIO ERROR - type of error (see enum GpioError)

********************* ReturnCode::ERR_RADAR_MSG ********************

MSB 8b 8b 8b 8b 8b 8b 8b 8b LSB

|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|
| REC. RADAR ID | EXP. RADAR ID | REC. MSG TYPE | EXP. MSG TYP | MSG ERROR | UART INSTANCE | RETURN CODE | METHOD |
|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|

Items:
METHOD - ID of lastly performed method (see enum Methods)
RETURN CODE - ReturnCode::ERR_RADAR_MSG
UART INSTANCE - instance of UART interface causing error (see enum UartInstance)
MSG ERROR - type of error (see enum RadarMessageError)
EXP. MSG TYPE - expected message type ID in received message (see enum IRadarMsg::MessageType)
REC. MSG TYPE - parsed message type ID from received message (see enum IRadarMsg::MessageType)
EXP. RADAR ID - expected radar ID in received message (see enum RadarId)
REC. RADAR ID - parsed radar ID from received message (see enum RadarId)

****************** ReturnCode::INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE ******************

MSB 48b 8b 8b LSB

|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|-------------—|
| UNUSED | RETURN CODE | METHOD |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|-------------—|

Items:
METHOD - ID of lastly performed method (see enum Methods)
RETURN CODE - ReturnCode::INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE

******************* ReturnCode::HRVS_SDK_ERROR *********************


MSB 40b 8b 8b 8b LSB
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|
| UNUSED | SDK ERROR | RETURN CODE | METHOD |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------—|-------------—|-------------—|-------------—|

Items:
METHOD - ID of lastly performed method (see enum Methods)
RETURN CODE - ReturnCode::HRVS_SDK_ERROR
SDK ERROR - type of error (see enum HrvsSdkErrorType)

******************** ReturnCode::EAP_MODEL_ERROR *******************

MSB 46 bit 1b 1b 8b 8b LSB
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|–|–|-------------—|-------------—|
| UNUSED |N2|N1| RETURN CODE | METHOD |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------—|–|–|-------------—|-------------—|

Items:
METHOD - Methods::RUN_MEASUREMENT
RETURN CODE - ReturnCode::EAP_MODEL_ERROR
N1 - 1 if maskIn is not zero, 0 otherwise
N2 - 1 if maskOut is not zero, 0 otherwise

********************************************************************
Note: Unused bits are always 0 for all types of status variable.
[out]resetErrorCounterReference where is copied count of errors caused by method hrvsConfiguration() or runMeasurement() in row (see variable resetErrorCounter).

◆ runMeasurement()

ReturnCode hrvs_sdk::RadarSystem::runMeasurement ( bool  inVelBodyValid = false,
float  inVelBodyX = 0.0f,
float  inVelBodyY = 0.0f,
float  inVelBodyZ = 0.0f 
)

Triggers one measurement and processes measurement data (unpacking, storing, logging).

Parameters
[in]inVelBodyValid(optional) Set this flag to true if you want to pass body velocity (parameters inVelBodyX, inVelBodyY, inVelBodyZ) to EAP model.
[in]inVelBodyX(optional) Input body velocity in x-axis [m/s] passed to EAP model which improve its performance. Data are used only when inVelBodyValid is set to true.
[in]inVelBodyY(optional) Input body velocity in y-axis [m/s] passed to EAP model which improve its performance. Data are used only when inVelBodyValid is set to true.
[in]inVelBodyZ(optional) Input body velocity in z-axis [m/s] passed to EAP model which improve its performance. Data are used only when inVelBodyValid is set to true.
Note
Use this method, if you want further process measured data from radars by own algorithm. After calling this method, you can extract measured data by getter methods.
Returns
Possible return codes: ReturnCode::OK | ReturnCode::METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED | ReturnCode::ERR_UART | ReturnCode::ERR_GPIO | ReturnCode::ERR_RADAR_MSG | ReturnCode::HRVS_SDK_ERROR | ReturnCode::EAP_MODEL_ERROR.
